title: Queen Pyrilonis and the Princesses
summary: Defeat the princess formations and keep fire constructs away from the raid.
overview: Six princesses guard Pyrilonis in two linked trios. Their portals activate after five seconds in combat, then every forty to sixty seconds, producing a chimera or fire construct.
Finishing one trio activates the other formation. All six princesses must die before the queen loses her damage protection.
Keep these enemies in their chamber. Crossing the boundary triggers a full heal, return home and hate clear at the next six-second check.

phases.label: Six princesses
phases.description: Control the linked trio, chimera reinforcements and constructs. Be ready for the second formation when the first falls.

phases.label: Queen Pyrilonis
phases.description: The queen becomes vulnerable. Her portals always produce fire constructs, beginning after five seconds in combat and recurring every forty to sixty seconds.

abilities.name: Fire construct pursuit
abilities.summary: Constructs move to the queen, then pursue a player.
description: A construct within three paces of its target casts Pyrilonis' Vengeance and disappears. Keep the pursuit away from the group. It also detonates if it loses a valid target.
